meta.name: i-have-adhd
meta.description: Shape output for a reader with ADHD: lead with the next action, number multi-step work, restate state across turns, suppress tangents, give specific time estimates, make wins visible. Invoke with /i-have-adhd; stays on until "stop adhd mode".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重组输出以适配多动症读者:先给动作、分步骤、限时反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让写出的说明和通知更容易被多动症同事或客户看懂
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your instructions to be clearer for colleagues or customers with ADHD.

howto.what: Claude 会以具体可执行的下一步动作开头，多步骤任务编号列出；每轮回复都会重述当前进度；抑制题外话，给出具体时间估计，并把已完成的工作标示出来；无开场白与结束语。
howto.when: 当你说出“/i-have-adhd”时启动，此后所有消息（如编码、调试、解释等）都会按 ADHD 友好格式输出，直到你说“stop adhd mode”停止。

say.note: 之后回复会先给动作，再解释。

howto.what_en: Claude starts each reply with a concrete next action, numbers multi-step tasks, restates the current progress every turn, suppresses tangents, gives specific time estimates, and surfaces completed work. No preamble, recap, or closing pleasantries.
howto.when_en: Activates when "/i-have-adhd" is said, stays on for all messages until "stop adhd mode" is said.
